facts.business: Veranda Learning Solutions Ltd. is a listed education company operating across three core verticals: Commerce Test prep, Academics, and Government Competition Test Preparation, while also retaining a 50% stake in its partnership with SNVA Veranda Limited focused on vocational and global higher education.

segments.name: Vocational and Global Higher Education (Partnership with SNVA EduTech)

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment and other intangible assets

guidance_or_targets.statement: Veranda enters FY27 with four clear priorities: geographic expansion, portfolio diversification, deepening presence across the education value chain, and strengthening existing verticals.
guidance_or_targets.value: Expand into Karnataka using localised content, faculty capabilities and offline coaching infrastructure; stronger offline presence across North and West India, particularly in Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Rajasthan and Gujarat; around 15 new offline college locations planned to accelerate growth in commerce education ecosystem.

facts.related_party_note: Acquisition of remaining minority stake in subsidiaries by Veranda Administrative Learning Solutions Private Limited (VALSPL) through share-swap arrangements and cash consideration; allotment of equity shares on preferential/private placement basis to shareholders of Veranda Administrative Learning Solutions Private Limited, BB Publication Private Limited, and Veranda XL Learning Solutions Private Limited as consideration for acquisitions; allotment to option holders under ESOP 2022.
